fusions.name: Stinging Cells
fusions.desc: Looses 3 stings at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage with a 25% chance to leave the target [Leaden] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Swarming Hold
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 11 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds and 30% slower for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Woven Skep
fusions.desc: Sets down a hive for 12 seconds. Every second it stings an enemy within 4 tiles and deals 3 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Sealing the Comb
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 6% of your maximum health per stack (45% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
